"""Exhaustive checks of the validation stages and their ordering."""
import json
import subprocess
import sys

MAIN = "/workspace/submission/main.py"


def run(lines):
    if isinstance(lines, bytes):
        payload = lines
    else:
        payload = b"".join(l if isinstance(l, bytes) else (l + "\n").encode() for l in lines)
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", MAIN], input=payload,
                       capture_output=True, cwd="/workspace/tmp/dev")
    assert p.returncode == 0, (p.returncode, p.stderr.decode()[:2000])
    out = p.stdout.decode()
    assert out.endswith("\n") or out == "", repr(out[-50:])
    return [json.loads(l) for l in out.splitlines()]


def E(code):
    return {"ok": False, "error": code}


BASE = {"services": ["a", "b"], "rules": [], "queries": []}
OK_REQ = {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "match", "path": ["a"]}}],
          "queries": [["a"], []]}

cases = []


def case(name, line, expect):
    cases.append((name, line, expect))


# ---- stage 1: line length / utf8 ----
case("long line", b'{"services":["' + b"x" * 1048577 + b'"]}', E("E_LIMIT"))
case("line exactly at limit (valid json prefix? too long content)",
     b'{"services":["' + b"x" * 1048555 + b'"],"rules":[],"queries":[]}', None)  # len?
case("invalid utf8", b'{"services":["\xff"]}', E("E_JSON"))
case("invalid utf8 overlong", b'{"services":["\xc0\x80"]}', E("E_JSON"))

# ---- stage 2: nesting depth ----
case("depth 65", "[" * 65 + "]" * 65, E("E_LIMIT"))
case("depth 64 ok", '{"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":' + "[" * 60 + "]" * 60 + "}", "ok")
case("depth 65 via mixed", "{" + "[" * 64 + "]" * 64 + "}", E("E_LIMIT"))
case("depth in string ignored", '{"services":["' + "[" * 200 + '"],"rules":[],"queries":[]}', "ok")
case("unbalanced closers", "]" * 100, E("E_JSON"))
case("depth exceeds inside invalid json", "[" * 70, E("E_LIMIT"))
case("depth 64 nested objects with strings",
     json.dumps({"services": [], "rules": [], "queries": []})[0:0] or
     b'{"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[[]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]]}', "ok")

# ---- stage 3: json errors ----
case("empty line", b"", E("E_JSON"))
case("whitespace line", b"   ", E("E_JSON"))
case("bare word", b"null", E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("number", b"42", E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("array", b"[1,2]", E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("trailing garbage", b'{"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":[]} x', E("E_JSON"))
case("trailing comma", b'{"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":[],}', E("E_JSON"))
case("single quotes", b"{'services':[]}", E("E_JSON"))
case("duplicate keys", b'{"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":[],"services":[]}', E("E_JSON"))
case("duplicate nested keys", b'{"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":[{"a":1,"a":2}]}', E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("NaN", b'{"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":[NaN]}', E("E_JSON"))
case("Infinity", b'{"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":[Infinity]}', E("E_JSON"))
case("-Infinity", b'{"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":[-Infinity]}', E("E_JSON"))
case("nan lowercase invalid", b'{"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":[nan]}', E("E_JSON"))
case("control char in string", b'{"services":["a\x01"],"rules":[],"queries":[]}', E("E_JSON"))
case("valid escapes", b'{"services":["a\\nb\\u0041\\"c"],"rules":[],"queries":[["a\\nb\\u0041\\"c"]]}', "ok")
case("escaped surrogate in service", b'{"services":["\\ud800"],"rules":[],"queries":[]}', E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("escaped surrogate in query", b'{"services":["a"],"rules":[],"queries":[["\\udfff"]]}', E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("escaped surrogate in key", b'{"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":[],"\\ud800":1}', E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("valid surrogate pair", b'{"services":["\\ud83d\\ude00"],"rules":[],"queries":[["\\ud83d\\ude00"]]}', "ok")

# ---- stage 4: schema ----
case("missing key", {"services": [], "rules": []}, E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("extra key", {"services": [], "rules": [], "queries": [], "x": 1}, E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("services not list", {"services": "a", "rules": [], "queries": []}, E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("service not string", {"services": [1], "rules": [], "queries": []}, E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("service null", {"services": [None], "rules": [], "queries": []}, E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("service empty", {"services": [""], "rules": [], "queries": []}, E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("duplicate services", {"services": ["a", "a"], "rules": [], "queries": []}, E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("rules not list", {"services": [], "rules": {}, "queries": []}, E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("rule not object", {"services": [], "rules": [1], "queries": []}, E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("rule extra key", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "true"}, "x": 1}], "queries": []}, E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("rule missing key", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow"}], "queries": []}, E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("bad action", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "ALLOW", "when": {"op": "true"}}], "queries": []}, E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("action not string", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": 1, "when": {"op": "true"}}], "queries": []}, E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("when not object", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": 1}], "queries": []}, E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("unknown op", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "xor", "args": []}}], "queries": []}, E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("op not string", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": 1}}], "queries": []}, E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("true with extra key", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "true", "x": 1}}], "queries": []}, E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("match missing path", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "match"}}], "queries": []}, E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("match path not list", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "match", "path": "a"}}], "queries": []}, E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("match unknown token", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "match", "path": ["b"]}}], "queries": []}, E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("match token not string", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "match", "path": [1]}}], "queries": []}, E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("not missing arg", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "not"}}], "queries": []}, E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("not arg not expr", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "not", "arg": 5}}], "queries": []}, E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("and args not list", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "and", "args": 5}}], "queries": []}, E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("and arg bad", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "and", "args": [1]}}], "queries": []}, E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("or with path key", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "or", "path": []}}], "queries": []}, E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("queries not list", {"services": [], "rules": [], "queries": {}}, E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("query not list", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [], "queries": ["a"]}, E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("query unknown token", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [], "queries": [["b"]]}, E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("query token not string", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [], "queries": [[1]]}, E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("query null", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [], "queries": [None]}, E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("rules null", {"services": [], "rules": None, "queries": []}, E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("queries null", {"services": [], "rules": [], "queries": None}, E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("services null", {"services": None, "rules": [], "queries": []}, E("E_SCHEMA"))

# ---- stage 5: size limits ----
case("25 services", {"services": ["s%d" % i for i in range(25)], "rules": [], "queries": []}, E("E_LIMIT"))
case("24 services ok", {"services": ["s%d" % i for i in range(24)], "rules": [], "queries": []}, "ok")
case("service 65 scalars", {"services": ["x" * 65], "rules": [], "queries": []}, E("E_LIMIT"))
case("service 64 scalars ok", {"services": ["x" * 64], "rules": [], "queries": []}, "ok")
case("service 64 unicode scalars", {"services": ["\U0001F600" * 64], "rules": [], "queries": []}, "ok")
case("33 rules", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "true"}}] * 33, "queries": []}, E("E_LIMIT"))
case("32 rules ok", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "true"}}] * 32, "queries": []}, "ok")
case("257 queries", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [], "queries": [[]] * 257}, E("E_LIMIT"))
case("256 queries ok", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [], "queries": [[]] * 256}, "ok")
case("query 4097 tokens", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [], "queries": [["a"] * 4097]}, E("E_LIMIT"))
case("query 4096 tokens ok", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [], "queries": [["a"] * 4096]}, "ok")
case("too many query tokens total", {"services": ["a", "b"], "rules": [],
                                     "queries": [["a"] * 4096, ["b"] * 4096, ["a"] * 4096,
                                                 ["b"] * 4096]}, E("E_LIMIT"))
case("16384 query tokens ok", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [], "queries": [["a"] * 4096] * 4}, "ok")
case("17-token atom path", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "match", "path": ["a"] * 17}}], "queries": []}, E("E_LIMIT"))
case("16-token atom path ok", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "match", "path": ["a"] * 16}}], "queries": []}, "ok")
case("11 distinct atoms", {"services": ["a", "b"],
                           "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "match", "path": ["a"] * i}}
                                     for i in range(1, 12)], "queries": []}, E("E_LIMIT"))
case("10 distinct atoms ok", {"services": ["a", "b"],
                              "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "match", "path": ["a"] * i}}
                                        for i in range(1, 11)], "queries": []}, "ok")
case("repeated atom counted once", {"services": ["a", "b"],
                                    "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "match", "path": ["a", "b"]}},
                                              {"action": "drop", "when": {"op": "match", "path": ["a", "b"]}},
                                              {"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "contains", "path": ["a", "b"]}}] * 3,
                                    "queries": []}, "ok")
case("33 args", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow",
                                              "when": {"op": "and", "args": [{"op": "true"}] * 33}}], "queries": []}, E("E_LIMIT"))
case("32 args ok", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow",
                                                 "when": {"op": "or", "args": [{"op": "false"}] * 32}}], "queries": []}, "ok")

def deep_expr(depth):
    e = {"op": "true"}
    for _ in range(depth):
        e = {"op": "not", "arg": e}
    return e

case("257 nodes", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": deep_expr(257)}], "queries": []}, E("E_LIMIT"))
case("256 nodes ok", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": deep_expr(256)}], "queries": []}, "ok")
case("256 nodes split", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": deep_expr(128)},
                                                     {"action": "drop", "when": deep_expr(128)}], "queries": []}, E("E_LIMIT"))
case("255 nodes split ok", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": deep_expr(128)},
                                                        {"action": "drop", "when": deep_expr(127)}], "queries": []}, "ok")

# ordering: schema beats limit
case("schema beats limit", {"services": ["a"] * 25, "rules": [{"action": "bad", "when": {"op": "true"}}], "queries": []}, E("E_SCHEMA"))
case("limit beats complexity", {"services": ["t%02d" % i for i in range(24)],
                                "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "contains", "path": ["t%02d" % ((i*7+j) % 24) for j in range(16)]}} for i in range(11)],
                                "queries": []}, E("E_LIMIT"))
case("json beats schema", b'{"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":[],"services":[]} extra', E("E_JSON"))
case("limit(depth) beats json", b'[' * 65 + b'bad', E("E_LIMIT"))

# ---- good edge cases ----
case("empty alphabet", {"services": [], "rules": [], "queries": []}, "ok")
case("empty alphabet with rules", {"services": [], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "true"}}], "queries": []}, "ok")
case("empty alphabet empty match", {"services": [], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "match", "path": []}}], "queries": [[]]}, "ok")
case("no rules", BASE, "ok")
case("drop only", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "drop", "when": {"op": "true"}}], "queries": [[]]}, "ok")
case("empty patterns", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [
    {"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "match", "path": []}},
    {"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "startswith", "path": []}},
    {"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "endswith", "path": []}},
    {"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "contains", "path": []}}], "queries": [[], ["a"]]}, "ok")
case("and empty args", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "and", "args": []}}], "queries": [[]]}, "ok")
case("or empty args", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "or", "args": []}}], "queries": [[]]}, "ok")
case("whitespace json", b'  {  "services" : [ "a" ] , "rules" : [ ] , "queries" : [ ] }  ', "ok")
case("crlf", b'{"services":["a"],"rules":[],"queries":[]}\r', "ok")

# ---- complexity ----
BIG = {"services": ["t%02d" % i for i in range(24)],
       "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "contains",
                 "path": ["t%02d" % ((i * 7 + j * 3) % 24) for j in range(16)]}} for i in range(10)],
       "queries": []}
case("complexity over", BIG, E("E_COMPLEXITY"))
case("complexity with unreachable branch", {"services": ["t%02d" % i for i in range(24)],
                                            "rules": [{"action": "allow",
                                                       "when": {"op": "and", "args": [{"op": "false"},
                                                                                       {"op": "contains", "path": ["t%02d" % ((i * 7 + j * 3) % 24) for j in range(16)]}]}}
                                                      for i in range(10)],
                                            "queries": []}, E("E_COMPLEXITY"))

# ---- processing continues after errors ----
case("multi-line mixed", [b'{"services":["a"],"rules":[],"queries":[]}', b'oops',
                          b'{"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":[]}'], ["ok", "E_JSON", "ok"])
case("no trailing newline", b'{"services":["a"],"rules":[],"queries":[]}', ["ok"])
case("empty stream", b"", [])
case("just newline", b"\n", ["E_JSON"])

def main():
    bad = 0
    for name, line, expect in cases:
        if isinstance(line, (dict, list)):
            line = json.dumps(line)
        if isinstance(line, str):
            line = line.encode()
        try:
            got = run([line])
        except Exception as exc:
            print("FAIL %-40s exception %s" % (name, exc))
            bad += 1
            continue
        if len(got) != 1:
            print("FAIL %-40s expected 1 line, got %d" % (name, len(got)))
            bad += 1
            continue
        g = got[0]
        if expect is None:
            print("INFO %-40s -> %s" % (name, g))
            continue
        if expect == "ok":
            ok = g.get("ok") is True and set(g.keys()) == {"ok", "dfa", "queries"}
        else:
            ok = g == E(expect)
        if not ok:
            print("FAIL %-40s expected %s got %s" % (name, expect, json.dumps(g)[:200]))
            bad += 1
    # multi-line cases
    for name, lines, expect in [("multi1", [b'{"services":["a"],"rules":[],"queries":[]}', b'oops',
                                            b'{"services":[],"rules":[],"queries":[]}'], None)]:
        pass
    print("checked %d cases, %d failures" % (len(cases), bad))
    return 1 if bad else 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
